notes: Replaced self-destructing Caffeine cache.get(key){loader} pattern with explicit getIfPresent+put in createVertex/createEdge for both CachingAgeGraphOperations and CachingNeo4jGraphOperations. Added invalidateReads() helper that clears only the 6 read caches, preserving createVertexCache and createEdgeCache across writes. Cache hits now return zero-overhead without triggering invalidation; cache misses delegate to DB, store result, then invalidate reads. Build verified (graph-age, graph-neo4j). Benchmarks ran sequentially. Geomean 0.01707 us/op across 14 sub-scores (7 age + 7 neo4j). Commit: experiment/round_6_executor_c.
